papers.title: Severe skeletal fragility in SCN8A-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.
papers.title_zh: SCN8A相关发育性脑病和癫痫性脑病的严重骨骼脆弱性。
papers.abstract: In this child with a phenotype compatible with the SCN8A gain-of-function spectrum, more than 20 bone fractures were documented. Together with previously reported cases, these observations raise the possibility that skeletal fragility may represent an underrecognized feature of the clinical spectrum associated with pathogenic SCN8A variants. Experimental and clinical findings provide biological plausibility for altered bone remodeling, while the marked reduction in fracture burden following pamidronate therapy underscores the importance of early recognition and management of skeletal complications in this population.
papers.abstract_zh:
在这名表型与SCN8A功能获得谱相容的儿童中，记录了20多例骨折。与先前报告的病例一起，这些观察结果提出了骨骼脆性可能代表与致病性SCN8A变异体相关的临床谱的一个未被充分认识的特征的可能性。实验和临床研究结果为改变的骨重塑提供了生物学上的合理性，而
帕米膦酸钠治疗后骨折负担的显着减轻强调了早期识别和管理该人群骨骼并发症的重要性。

papers.title: Household-level health and economic spillover effects associated with adult epilepsy in the United States.
papers.title_zh: 与美国成人癫痫相关的家庭级健康和经济溢出效应。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Epilepsy is associated with substantial health-related and economic burden, and prior spillover research has largely focused on caregivers. Little is known about the impact of epilepsy on other adults living in the same household. This study examined household-level spillover effects associated with epilepsy on mental health, productivity, and health care utilization and expenditures among adults without epilepsy.
METHODS: This cross-sectional study used 2017-2023 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey data to analyze adults aged 18 years and older without epilepsy living in households with versus without an adult with epilepsy. Adults in epilepsy households were compared with those in no-epilepsy households across sociodemographic characteristics, work-related outcomes, health-related quality of life, emotional well-being, and health care utilization and expenditures. Person- and survey-weighted regression models were used to estimate adjusted associations, clustering at the household level.
RESULTS: Adults without epilepsy living in epilepsy households had significantly lower mental health-related quality of life (adjusted mean difference = -2.1 points), 55% higher odds of missing work to care for others, and 52% higher odds of reporting worse general health than adults without epilepsy living in no-epilepsy households. Unadjusted person-level income was lower by approximately $3400 and health care expenditures were higher by approximately $5500 among adults without epilepsy living in an epilepsy household, although adjusted differences were not statistically significant.
SIGNIFICANCE: Adults without epilepsy living with an adult with epilepsy experience meaningful mental, emotional, and productivity spillover effects. Findings from this study suggest that the effects of epilepsy extend beyond the diagnosed individual to other adults living in the same household, and support the need for clinical, supportive, and policy approaches that address household-level consequences of the condition.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：癫痫与大量的健康相关和经济负担有关，之前的溢出研究主要集中在护理人员身上。 关于癫痫对生活在同一家庭中的其他成年人的影响，人们知之甚少。 本研究研究了与癫痫相关的家庭层面的溢出效应对无癫痫的成年人的心理健康、生产力、医疗保健利用率和支出的影响。
方法：这个交叉
ectional研究使用2017-2023年医疗支出小组调查数据来分析生活在有癫痫与无癫痫成人家庭中的18岁及以上无癫痫成人。将癫痫家庭的成年人与非癫痫家庭的成年人在社会人口统计学特征、与工作相关的结果、与健康相关的生活质量、情绪健康以及医疗保健利用和支出方面进行比较。
urvey加权回归模型用于估计调整后的关联，在家庭层面进行聚类。
结果：生活在癫痫家庭中的非癫痫成人的心理健康相关生活质量显著较低（调整后平均差异= -2.1分） ，缺勤照顾他人的几率高出55% ，与生活在非癫痫家庭中的非癫痫成人相比，报告总体健康状况较差的几率高出52%。
居住在癫痫家庭中无癫痫的成年人中，调整后的个人水平收入降低了约3400美元，医疗保健支出增加了约5500美元，尽管调整后的差异没有统计学意义。
意义：与癫痫成人一起生活的非癫痫成人会经历有意义的心理、情绪和生产力溢出效应。 这项研究的结果表明， ef
癫痫的症状从被诊断的个体扩展到生活在同一家庭中的其他成年人，并支持对临床、支持和政策方法的需求，以解决该病症的家庭层面后果。

papers.title: Taking a clinical history in adolescents and adults presenting with seizures or epilepsy.
papers.title_zh: 记录患有癫痫发作或癫痫的青少年和成人的临床病史。
papers.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
papers.abstract: Despite advances in EEG, neuroimaging, and other diagnostic technologies, a carefully obtained clinical history remains the cornerstone of diagnosis, classification, and treatment planning. However, structured guidance on history-taking that integrates state-of-the-art evidence and the updated 2025 International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE) seizure classification is limited. We performed a review of evidence published between January 2000 and April 2026, supplemented by landmark earlier studies, ILAE position papers, and National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidelines. Evidence was synthesized to develop a practical framework for obtaining and interpreting the clinical history in adolescents and adults presenting with a first seizure, recurrent seizures, or established epilepsy. We present a structured approach that follows the sequence of a clinical consultation, encompassing the presenting complaint, detailed event reconstruction, semiology, collateral witness accounts, smartphone video recordings, seizure triggers and temporal patterns, past medical history, medication review, family history, social factors, and safety issues. We discuss the diagnostic value of individual history elements, practical strategies for distinguishing epileptic seizures from functional/dissociative seizures and syncope, and the contribution of history-taking to seizure classification under the updated 2025 ILAE framework. We also summarize clinically relevant risk factors, comorbidities, and management implications that influence diagnostic accuracy and individualized care. Practical diagnostic questionnaires are provided to facilitate differential diagnosis and seizure classification, particularly for clinicians without specialist epilepsy expertise. A systematic clinical history, obtained from the individual and eyewitnesses and complemented by video recordings when available, remains the single most important diagnostic tool in epilepsy. Structured history-taking improves diagnostic accuracy, reduces misdiagnosis, supports accurate seizure classification, guides appropriate investigations, and provides the foundation for personalized management. This practical framework offers an evidence-based approach that can be readily incorporated into routine clinical practice and education across diverse healthcare settings.
papers.abstract_zh:
尽管脑电图、神经影像和其他诊断技术取得了进展，但精心获取的临床病史仍然是诊断、分类和治疗计划的基石。然而，整合最先进证据和更新的2025年国际抗癫痫联盟（ ILAE ）癫痫发作分类的结构化历史记录指导是有限的。我们对2000年1月至2000年1月期间公布的证据进行了审查。
pRIL 2026 ，辅以具有里程碑意义的早期研究、ILAE立场文件和国家健康与护理卓越研究所（ NICE ）指南。综合证据以开发用于获得和解释患有首次癫痫发作、复发性癫痫发作或已确立癫痫的青少年和成人临床病史的实用框架。我们提出了一种遵循临床会诊顺序的结构化方法， e
包括呈报投诉、详细的事件重建、符号学、附带证人账户、智能手机视频录制、癫痫发作触发和时间模式、既往病史、药物审查、家族史、社会因素和安全问题。我们讨论了单个病史要素的诊断价值，区分癫痫发作与功能性/分离性癫痫发作和晕厥的实用策略，以及
e在更新的2025 ILAE框架下，历史记录对癫痫发作分类的贡献。我们还总结了影响诊断准确性和个体化护理的临床相关危险因素、合并症和管理影响。提供实用的诊断问卷，以促进鉴别诊断和癫痫发作分类，特别是对于没有专科癫痫专业知识的临床医生。
从个人和目击者那里获得并辅以视频记录的病史仍然是癫痫最重要的诊断工具。结构化历史记录可提高诊断准确性，减少误诊，支持准确的癫痫发作分类，指导适当的调查，并为个性化管理提供基础。这个实用的框架提供了一种基于证据的方法，
可以很容易地纳入各种医疗保健环境中的常规临床实践和教育。

papers.title: Stereoelectroencephalography-based anatomo-electro-clinical subtyping reveals network-specific organization in parietal lobe epilepsy.
papers.title_zh: 基于立体脑电图的解剖学-电临床亚型分型揭示了顶叶癫痫的网络特异性组织。
papers.abstract:
AIMS: This study aimed to use stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) to delineate the anatomo-electro-clinical correlations between seizure semiology and Brodmann area-based functional subregions in parietal lobe epilepsy (PLE), so as to improve the precise localization of seizure onset and the accuracy of presurgical diagnosis.
METHODS: Patients with PLE who underwent SEEG were retrospectively included. Intracranial electrode contacts were localized based on Brodmann area (BA) anatomical divisions. Seizure semiology and ictal SEEG evolution were systematically quantified using a predefined scoring system. Hierarchical cluster analysis and principal component analysis (PCA) were applied to identify correlations between clinical signs, involved anatomical subregions, and early propagation networks.
RESULTS: Four distinct subtypes of PLE were identified based on the analysis of 23 patients: (1) an autonomic symptoms subtype involving BA43 and the insulo-opercular region; (2) a posterior parietal subtype centered on BA7 with contralateral versive sign and absence of autonomic symptoms; (3) a BA39-dominant subtype characterized by staring/behavioural arrest and automatisms; (4) a somatosensory subtype involving BA3.1.2 with localized somesthetic aura and no automatisms. Correlation analysis revealed a posterior-anterior gradient between semiology and BA subregions.
CONCLUSION: SEEG-based subtyping reveals network-organized seizure semiology and improves the localization precision of the seizure onset zone (SOZ) in PLE.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：本研究旨在利用立体脑电图（ SEEG ）描绘顶叶癫痫（ PLE ）中癫痫发作特征与Brodmann区域功能亚区之间的解剖-电临床相关性，以提高癫痫发作的精确定位和术前诊断的准确性。
方法：回顾性纳入接受SEEG的PLE患者。 颅内电极触点已定位
d基于Brodmann面积（ BA ）解剖学划分。 使用预定义的评分系统对癫痫发作符号和发作期seeG进化进行系统量化。 应用分层聚类分析和主成分分析（ PCA ）来识别临床体征、受累解剖亚区和早期传播网络之间的相关性。
结果：根据对23例患者的分析，确定了PLE的四种不同亚型： （
1 ）涉及BA43和胰岛素囊区的自主症状亚型； （ 2 ）以BA7为中心的后壁亚型，具有对侧反向征，没有自主症状； （ 3 ）以凝视/行为骤停和自动性为特征的BA39显性亚型； （ 4 ）涉及BA3.1.2的躯体感觉亚型，具有局部躯体感觉光环，没有自动性。相关性分析显示，两者之间存在前后梯度
n符号学和BA子区域。
结论：基于SEEG的亚型分型揭示了网络组织的癫痫发作语义，并提高了PLE中癫痫发作区（ SOZ ）的定位精度。

papers.title: Epilepsy as a marker of cognitive decline in cerebral amyloid angiopathy: Evidence from a large multi-institutional cohort.
papers.title_zh: 癫痫作为脑淀粉样血管疾病认知能力下降的标志：来自大型多机构队列的证据
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) is an amyloid mediated cortical and leptomeningeal small-vessel disease that commonly presents with lobar intracerebral hemorrhage, cognitive impairment, and transient neurological symptoms. Epilepsy occurs in 20-33 % of patients with CAA, but their association with cognitive function and survival remains incompletely defined.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Mayo Clinic Platform, which contains multi-institutional de-identified longitudinal electronic health records. Adult patients (≥18 years) with CAA were identified using ICD-10 code I68.0 and natural language processing of clinical notes including Boston criteria 2.0. Epilepsy was defined per ILAE criteria with ICD-10 codes and documentation in clinical notes, and cognitive dysfunction diagnosis was confirmed using patient history. Propensity score matching (1:1) was performed at the date of CAA diagnosis. Time-to-event outcomes were estimated using Kaplan-Meier methods and Cox proportional hazards regression for 60 months follow-up.
RESULT: Among the 2717 patients with CAA (mean age 74.5 years), 733 patients (27.0 %) had epilepsy. 673 propensity score-matched pairs were included in the final analysis. Epilepsy was associated with a higher risk of cognitive dysfunction (HR 1.34, 95 % CI 1.13-1.60). No statistically significant difference was noted in all-cause mortality between cohorts (HR 1.07, 95 % CI 0.86-1.33).
CONCLUSION: Epilepsy in patients with CAA was associated with higher risk of cognitive decline. There was no difference in all-cause mortality, but the confidence interval does not exclude a clinically meaningful effect in either direction. These findings highlight patients with epilepsy as a subgroup of CAA cases with increased risk for cognitive decline. Prospective studies with validated cognitive assessments are needed to confirm this association.
papers.abstract_zh:
简介：脑淀粉样血管疾病（ CAA ）是一种淀粉样蛋白介导的皮质和脑膜小血管疾病，通常伴有脑叶内出血、认知障碍和短暂的神经系统症状。 癫痫发生在20-33 ％的CAA患者中，但它们与认知功能和生存的关系仍未完全确定。
方法：我们使用Mayo Clinic进行了一项回顾性队列研究
平台，其中包含多机构去识别的纵向电子健康记录。使用ICD-10代码I68.0和临床笔记的自然语言处理（包括波士顿标准2.0 ）识别CAA的成年患者（ ≥ 18岁）。根据ILAE标准定义癫痫，在临床笔记中记录ICD-10代码和记录，并使用患者病史确认认知功能障碍诊断。倾向得分匹配（
1: 1)在CAA诊断之日进行。 使用Kaplan-Meier方法和Cox比例风险回归评估事件发生的时间结局，随访60个月。
结果：在2717名CAA患者（平均年龄74.5岁）中， 733名患者（ 27.0% ）患有癫痫。最终分析包括673对倾向评分匹配的患者。 癫痫与较高的认知功能障碍风险相关（ HR 1.34, 95% CI 1.13-1.60 ）。
o队列间全因死亡率有统计学显著性差异（ HR 1.07 ， 95% CI 0.86-1.33 ）。
结论： CAA患者的癫痫与较高的认知能力下降风险相关。 全因死亡率无差异，但置信区间不排除任何方向的临床意义效应。 这些发现突出显示癫痫患者是CAA病例的一个亚组，
认知能力下降的风险。需要具有经过验证的认知评估的前瞻性研究来证实这种关联。

papers.title: Genotype-phenotype correlations in KCNA2 related neurodevelopmental disorder: expanding the clinical and molecular spectrum.
papers.title_zh: KCNA2相关神经发育障碍的基因型-表型相关性：扩展临床和分子谱。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pathogenic variants in KCNA2 are associated with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 32 (DEE32), but genotype-phenotype correlations remain unclear.
METHODS: Whole-exome sequencing was performed in patients with developmental delay and/or epilepsy. Previously reported KCNA2 variants were reviewed to assess pathogenicity and genotype-phenotype associations. Structural modeling, in silico prediction, and spatiotemporal expression analyses were conducted to evaluate the potential effects of variants.
RESULTS: Four patients from unrelated families were identified with KCNA2 missense variants, including two novel variants, c.749T>G (p.Phe250Cys) and c.986G>A (p.Gly329Asp), and the recurrent variant c.1214C>T (p.Pro405Leu) in two patients. All patients presented with seizures, with or without mild developmental delay. Integrated analysis suggested that loss-of-function (LOF) variants were more likely to alter hydrophobicity, hydrogen bonding, and protein stability, and showed higher AlphaMissense scores, whereas gain-of-function (GOF) and mixed-function variants appeared less structurally damaging. Literature review showed that seizure onset was mostly in infancy or early childhood, consistent with the developmental expression pattern of KCNA2. LOF variants were generally associated with absent or mild developmental delay, while GOF and mixed-function variants were more frequently linked to severe developmental impairment.
CONCLUSION: This study expands the KCNA2 variant spectrum and supports a potential association between variant functional class and clinical severity. Integrating clinical data, structural modeling, and developmental expression analysis may improve understanding of KCNA2-related epilepsy and neurodevelopmental disorders.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景： KCNA2中的致病变异与发育和癫痫性脑病32 （ DEE32 ）相关，但基因型-表型相关性尚不清楚。
方法：对发育迟缓和/或癫痫患者进行全外显子组测序。 对先前报道的KCNA2变异进行了综述，以评估致病性和基因型-表型关联。 结构建模、电脑预测和时空表达
进行分析以评估变异的潜在影响。
结果：在两名患者中，来自非亲缘家族的四名患者被鉴定为KCNA2错义变异，包括两种新变异， c.749T > G （ p.Phe250Cys ）和c.986G > A （ p.Gly329Asp ） ，以及复发变异c.1214C > T （ p.Pro405Leu ）。 所有患者均出现癫痫发作，有或无轻度发育迟缓。 综合分析表明，功能丧失（ LOF ）
变异体更有可能改变疏水性、氢键和蛋白质稳定性，并显示出更高的AlphaMissense评分，而功能增益（ GOF ）和混合功能变异体在结构上损伤较小。文献综述表明，癫痫发作多发生在婴幼儿期，与KCNA2的发育表达模式一致。LOF变异通常与发育缺失或轻度相关。
延迟，而GOF和混合功能变异更常与严重的发育障碍有关。
结论：本研究扩展了KCNA2变异谱，并支持变异功能分类与临床严重程度之间的潜在关联。 整合临床数据、结构建模和发育表达分析可以提高对KCNA2相关癫痫和神经发育障碍的理解。

papers.title: Preliminary evidence of long-term safety and effectiveness of anti-CGRP drugs for migraine prevention in people with comorbid epilepsy: A 52-week follow-up retrospective study.
papers.title_zh: 抗CGRP药物在合并癫痫患者中预防偏头痛的长期安全性和有效性的初步证据：一项为期52周的随访回顾性研究。
papers.abstract: Migraine and epilepsy frequently coexist, but evidence on the safety of calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)-targeting therapies in people with epilepsy is lacking. We evaluated long-term migraine and epilepsy outcomes in a real-world multicenter retrospective cohort of adults with comorbid migraine and epilepsy treated with anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies or gepants while on stable antiseizure medications. Eleven patients were included in the final analysis, all female, with a mean age of 34.7 ± 12.2 years. At baseline, mean monthly headache days (MHDs) were 18.5 ± 7.8, with 54.5% episodic migraine and 45.5% chronic migraine; 72.7% of patients had drug-resistant epilepsy, and baseline mean monthly seizure frequency was 0.75. Mean MHDs decreased to 7.6 ± 5.5 at 24 weeks and to 5.4 ± 3.2 at 52 weeks (p < 0.001). At week 24, 90% of patients achieved a ≥50% reduction in MHDs, which was maintained at week 52; ≥75% response increased from 10% at week 24 to 20% at week 52, and 10% achieved migraine freedom at 1 year; MIDAS and HIT6 scores decreased significantly from baseline to both 24 and 52 weeks (all p < 0.001). Acute medication days and intake were reduced by over 85% at the end of the study. Seizure frequency did not increase during follow-up and showed a non-significant numerical reduction to 0.40 monthly seizures at 52 weeks (p = 0.423). No seizure exacerbations or treatment-related adverse events were observed. This study provides preliminary, long-term observations suggesting that anti-CGRP therapies may be effective for migraine prevention in patients with comorbid epilepsy. No adverse events or apparent worsening of seizure frequency were observed during the 52-week follow-up. These findings require confirmation in larger, prospective controlled studies. PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Migraine and epilepsy often occur together, but information on CGRP-targeting migraine medicines in people with epilepsy is limited. We reviewed records from 11 women with both conditions over 1 year. Headache, migraine-related disability, and use of medicines for attacks decreased. Among 10 women with complete migraine follow-up, nine had at least half as many headache days at both 6 months and 1 year. No worsening of seizures or treatment-related side effects was reported. These findings are encouraging, but this small study without a comparison group cannot establish safety or prove treatment benefit.
papers.abstract_zh:
偏头痛和癫痫经常共存，但缺乏降钙素基因相关肽（ CGRP ）靶向治疗癫痫患者的安全性证据。我们评估了接受抗CGRP单克隆抗体或巨人稳定抗癫痫药物治疗的成年人合并偏头痛和癫痫的真实世界多中心回顾性队列的长期偏头痛和癫痫结局。11名患者被纳入
最终分析，所有女性，平均年龄为34.7 ± 12.2岁。在基线时，平均每月头痛天数（ MHD ）为18.5 ± 7.8 ，其中54.5%为发作性偏头痛， 45.5%为慢性偏头痛； 72.7%的患者患有耐药性癫痫，基线平均每月癫痫发作频率为0.75。平均MHD在24周时降至7.6 ± 5.5 ，在52周时降至5.4 ± 3.2 （ p < 0.001 ）。在第24周， 90%的患者的MHD减少≥ 50% ，即
第52周入组； ≥ 75%缓解率从第24周的10%增加到第52周的20% ， 10%在第1年实现了偏头痛消失； MIDAS和HIT6评分从基线到第24周和52周均显著下降（均p < 0.001 ）。在研究结束时，急性用药天数和摄入量减少了85%以上。随访期间癫痫发作频率没有增加， 52周时每月癫痫发作次数减少到0.40次
（ p = 0.423 ）。未观察到癫痫发作加重或治疗相关不良事件。该研究提供了初步、长期的观察结果，表明抗CGRP治疗可能对合并癫痫患者的偏头痛预防有效。在52周随访期间未观察到不良事件或癫痫发作频率明显恶化。这些发现需要在更大规模的前瞻性对照研究中得到证实。
综述：偏头痛和癫痫通常一起发生，但癫痫患者中CGRP靶向偏头痛药物的信息有限。我们回顾了11名患有这两种疾病的女性超过1年的记录。头痛、偏头痛相关残疾以及使用药物治疗发作减少。在10名完全偏头痛随访的女性中， 9名患者在6个月和1年的头痛天数至少是一半。癫痫发作无恶化o
r报告了治疗相关的副作用。这些发现令人鼓舞，但这项没有对照组的小型研究无法确定安全性或证明治疗获益。
